stage.value: listing — classic sell form, category step

job.value: choose the category for the item being listed

arrivedFrom.value: 'Fill in manually', a draft or Edit listing

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The large 'Choose Category' title with the item photo and 'Search for a category' says exactly what to do.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The search field and the tappable category rows are the main elements.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Each row shows its full path, e.g. 'Dresses — Women's Fashion > Dresses & Sets', so a tap's outcome is clear.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Niche names like 'Raw Singles' are explained by their path 'Toys & Collectibles > Trading Cards'.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The seller can pick a category, but the only 'SUGGESTED' option for a camera photo is 'Everything Else', so the suggestion doesn't help them decide.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The rest of the taxonomy sits behind search and scroll.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is about choosing a category.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Row names and paths carry it; no explanatory copy.
